messages.subject: Question with error (argument is missing)
parts:
I'm working on my first shinyapp.  It's a simple plot.  I'm getting an error message on my selectinput line in the server.r file. What argument am I missing?

ui.r

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  
  # Application title
  titlePanel("US Violent Crime rate per 100,000"),
  
  # Sidebar with a Panel input
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("crime", "Please Select Crime Type", choices=c("All", "Murder", "Rape", "Robbery", "Assault")),
    ),
    
    # Show a plot of the generated distribution
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("Plot")
    )
  )
))


server.r

data<- read.csv("FBI.csv"); ##attach(data);

library (ggplot2);
 
  # Expression that generates a graph. The expression is
  # wrapped in a call to renderPlot to indicate that:
  #
  #  1) It is "reactive" and therefore should re-execute automatically
  #     when inputs change
  #  2) Its output type is a plot

ShinyServer(function(input, output){ 
  
  output$Plot <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(data, aes(Year, input$crime)) + geom_line() + geom_point()
  })
})
